name: Indus Hospital
mission:
Friends of Indus Hospital, Inc (FOIH) is a US-based 501(c)(3) registered charity. We strive to create awareness about the healthcare needs of underprivileged patients and raise funds to provide them with equitable care. By supporting healthcare efforts in Pakistan, FOIH is helping to ensure that vulnerable individuals have access to the healthcare they need, regardless of financial or other barriers.
Through annual fundraising initiatives, community events, and awareness drives, we seek to mobilize a strong tradition of community giving and a shared commitment to changing the paradigm of healthcare delivery in Pakistan.
FOIH is an initiative taken by Americans of Pakistani origin expatriates and supported by a wider community across the USA.
All donations given to FOIH are eligible for tax deduction under US law.

rich_narrative.summary: Friends of Indus Hospital Inc supports a vital network of healthcare facilities in Pakistan, providing <cite id="1">free, high-quality medical care</cite> to underserved families. The organization acts as the U.S. fundraising arm for the Indus Hospital & Health Network, which delivers services ranging from <cite id="2">neonatal care to prosthetic limbs</cite>. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="3">total revenue of $14,742,480</cite>, maintaining a stable financial position despite a <cite id="4">three-year revenue CAGR of -2.6%</cite>. The organization is distinguished by its commitment to direct service delivery. It ensures that <cite id="5">86.8% of its expenses</cite> go directly toward medical programs. This efficiency is supported by a lean fundraising model. The charity spends only <cite id="6">$0.11 to raise every $1</cite> in donations. While the organization is highly effective at resource mobilization, it operates with <cite id="7">1.8 months of working capital</cite>. This lean reserve level suggests that the charity quickly deploys funds to Pakistan to meet urgent medical needs. Donors can have high confidence in the organization's transparency. It holds a <cite id="8">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite> and an <cite id="9">overall score of 87.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>.
